basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old music enthusiast living in Denver, Colorado. During the weekdays, I work as a software developer for a tech startup, which allows me the flexibility to explore my passion for music in my free time. I often spend my evenings jamming on my guitar or exploring new DLCs for Rockband on my PS4. I'm an avid skier and try to hit the slopes as much as possible during the winter months. I'm currently single, which gives me plenty of time to engage with my hobbies and participate in online communities. I'm usually online late in the evenings, often browsing Reddit while unwinding after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which has helped me develop a strong technical background. My love for music and gaming led me to self-teach guitar, and I frequently keep up with the latest Rockband updates and DLC offerings. I'm also knowledgeable about skiing and enjoy discussing techniques and equipment in related forums.
